charts.title: fig08-executable-dynamics
charts.caption: Interactive Fig 8: the central-dogma cascade across six nested levels. mRNA (rna) rises 0 → 0.178 as transcription reads DNA nested five levels down; the ribosome pool at the deepest-nested organelle leaf climbs 0.5 → 0.501 as it is actively maintained; protein rises 0 → 0.008 as translation reads RNA plus that ribosome pool. Molecular mechanisms compose into a six-level nested place graph, and the interface survives the deepest nesting (Law 2). Honest framing: complementarity/selectivity is the paper's organizing idea for why such hierarchies form, not a mechanism this executable builds — what is demonstrated is hierarchical assembly, a coupled cascade reading and writing fixed, pre-wired store paths with no binding-affinity calculation.
